requirements.detail: Failure export exists; multi-page native fetch remains broken (#1).
Capture, explicit refusal, atomic outcome classification and exactly-once handling present; refusal-class coverage remains incomplete (#6).
Views/reporting exist; list counts/signatures and bounded catalog work need #3-5.
Count/byte retention and pair transactions present; byte-limit eviction coverage remains a testing gap.
Guide updated but dedicated fetch instructions contradict the feature (#2).
Models/fuzz/scoped proof artifacts exist; final authoritative checks remain parent-owned and are not certified by this review.
Core implementation is present; six confirmed findings and final verification prevent completion.

agent_native_gaps: Embedded guide incorrectly denies implemented failure capture and export; included as a primary finding.
residual_risks: Capture model checks publication/counting under whole-pair atomicity abstraction; concrete SQLite crash boundaries rely on process tests. CBMC proves bounded slice arithmetic, not whole-record or SQLite behavior.
testing_gaps: Retention tests use one-byte records, while sizing writes only one kind twice retained. Add a distinct-kind scenario that reaches the 64 MiB byte cap before 64 records, verifying whole-kind oldest-latest eviction and that an existing kind cannot evict another kind's first record to grow its latest.

The retained-context test asserts only context.length != 0; work/heap tests inspect class and configured budgets. A missing frame walk would still leave 'variables unavailable' text and satisfy these checks. Assert an expected live frame/span and top-frame variable for a defect, plus a live frame for cancellation and successful subsequent service work after cleanup.
